# Goban Studio v18.0.0

v18 adds no features. It makes the board you play on, and the first
minutes with the app, look and feel right: a new board in pale kaya that
stays light in the dark theme, cleaner stones and signals on it, a calmer
game screen, one set of colours across the app, a Windows installer, and
a first stone in three clicks. v18 reads everything v9–v17 saved;
nothing has to be converted.

## Download and first launch

<!-- first-launch -->
| Platform | File | First launch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `GobanStudio-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| macOS (Intel) | `GobanStudio-macOS-x64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| Windows (x64) | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.msi` (installer, recommended) | See the package README. |
| Windows (x64), portable | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.zip` | See the package README. |
<!-- /first-launch -->

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of every file. v18 needs macOS 13 or
later. Your games, progress and settings are kept outside the app — in
`~/Library/Application Support/dev.hxddh.gobanstudio` on macOS and
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.hxddh.gobanstudio\Data` on Windows — so replacing the
app keeps them.

## The board

- **Pale kaya.** The board is a warmer, clearer wood (`#E6C487`) instead
  of the greyish one; its grain is broad bands of colour only, with no
  fine lines that run beside the grid and read as extra lines.
- **The dark theme keeps a light board.** Around it the app is dark; the
  board itself is the same wood a little dimmer, so black stones, lines
  and coordinates read as well as by day (black on the board is at least
  7:1, lines and coordinates at least 4.5:1, and tests keep them so).
- **Stones.** White stones are brighter, with their shade at the edge
  only; the frame is narrower, without the plastic highlight.
- **The preview of your next move** is a clean disc of your colour, no
  longer a brown smudge with the grid showing through.

## The game screen

- In the dark theme the move list's black stones are dark discs, its
  white ones bright: no more grey third colour.
- The opponent's "thinking" dots breathe slowly instead of blinking, and
  stand still with reduced motion.
- At 1280×800 a 19×19 board keeps cells of 34 px; a check keeps it from
  shrinking.

## One set of colours

- The exported review image draws its boards in the board's own wood,
  like the thumbnails.
- The six places are checked in the dark theme too, against screenshots.

## First launch

- **Windows has an installer.** `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.msi` installs
  for your Windows user without an administrator: a Start menu entry,
  `.sgf` files open in Goban Studio, and it uninstalls from Settings →
  Apps. In-app updates keep working when installed. The zip stays as the
  portable download. CI installs, starts, updates, upgrades and
  uninstalls the installer on every release.
- **A first stone in three clicks**, whatever you answer at the start.
  Someone who plays and gives a rank now starts their 19×19 game from that
  step; beginners still land on Today, one click from lesson one or a
  gentle 9×9 game.

## Known limits

- **Platform code has not been tried by hand.** The Metal and AVX2
  engines and their fallback, the speed they reach, a save surviving a
  power cut, the macOS title bar following the app's appearance, and the
  Windows installer pass their tests and the packaged self-test on CI,
  but nobody has run them on a real Mac or PC. Settings → Engines →
  Measure speed is there to check the first two; please report what it
  shows.
- **Not checked by people.** The new board's colours were chosen from
  screenshots; the stone sounds and animations, the lessons, the KataGo
  notes on the classics, the move verdicts and the strings in Chinese,
  Korean and Japanese have not been reviewed by a strong player or native
  speakers.
- **Lessons KataGo disagrees with.** A few lessons on small 9×9 boards
  teach the local shape while KataGo prefers a big point elsewhere, and
  the 3-3 joseki teaches the standard connection where KataGo prefers a
  cut (`docs/lesson-audit.md`); they are left as taught.
- **The builds are not code-signed**, the installer included. macOS and
  Windows warn on first launch; the README in each download says what to
  do.
- **No Traditional Chinese interface.** The problem bank tops out at
  about 5 kyu.
